summary: Iteration 2: full e2e test of new multi-tenant 3-step auth + role-scoping + 4 provider dashboards. Backend: 30/30 pytest tests passed (new file /app/backend/tests/test_multitenant.py) covering send-otp/verify-otp/set-password/login-password, wrong OTP=400, unknown phone=403, wrong password=401, expired temp token=401, master admin first-time setup, all 4 providers login with role=provider_owner + correct provider_type/provider_id, internal-only endpoints 403 for providers (dashboard/stats, activity-feed, pipeline, analytics, team, export.csv, PATCH /contacts), scoping (contacts: 1 own row only, activities: only those with provider_id in provider_ids, GET /contacts/{other} = 403, search scoped), provider endpoints (/api/provider/me, /api/provider/dashboard with type-specific extras hospital{total_beds,available_beds,occupancy_pct,incoming_today}/ambulance{fleet_size,avg_response_min,live_trips,trips_completed}/clinic{appointments_today,no_show_rate_pct}/pathology{samples_collected,reports_ready,pending_bookings}, /api/provider/activities), admin blocked from /api/provider/*. Frontend: 15/16 playwright checks passed - hospital provider login redirects to /provider, provider sidebar shows only [My Dashboard, My Activities, Profile & KYC, Tasks] (no Contacts/Pipeline/Analytics/Team), DEMO DATA badge hidden for providers, hospital dashboard renders type-themed banner + 4 generic KPIs + hospital extras (beds + occupancy bar + incoming) + 14-day chart + donut + live activity feed (auto-refreshes 30s), provider /contacts redirects to /provider, /provider/activities lists rows (6 for hospital), /provider/profile renders with KYC badge, logout works. Ambulance/clinic/pathology each show their type-specific KPI block. Master admin login routes to /, admin sidebar shows all 7 internal items, admin hitting /provider redirects back to /. The 1 failed FE check was a test-script artifact (session still active when navigating to login), not a product bug; the equivalent wrong-password=401 already verified at backend level.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1336 lines - still single-file. Recommend splitting into modules (auth/seed/contacts/activities/provider/internal) for maintainability.

Provider dashboard hospital extras are nested under 'kpis' alongside the 4 generic KPIs rather than under a separate 'extras' key. Functional, but a cleaner shape would be d['kpis'] + d['extras']. Frontend already handles current layout.

Mock OTP message exposes the OTP value in /api/auth/send-otp response ('use 123456 for testing'). Acceptable for dev/mock mode but must be gated behind a dev flag before going live with upstream federation.
Provider dashboard polls every 30s with no exponential backoff on error - acceptable, but if backend goes down it will spam. Consider adding cancel on tab-hidden.
